entries.def: - sometimes used for G5127; of this person

τοὐναντίον 
by crasis for τὸ ἐνανίον, neut. accusative, used adverbially, on the contrary, contrariwise: 2Co.2.7, Gal.2.7, 1Pe.3.9.†
(AS)

τοὔνομα 
by crasis for τὸ ὄνομα, accusative absol., 
by name: Mat.27.57.†
(AS)

that is 
that is to say, by this we mean
this (person, as objective of verb or preposition)
